domain: every integer r>=1 and every Enterprise center O

claims.fixed_center: O is unchanged by every tau branch
claims.legal_adjacency: every tau call emits exactly one of the three canonical first-sector unit edges transported by R^sector, hence one of the six Enterprise adjacency directions globally
claims.first_sector: the L recurrence equals the accepted AH left half; the midline residual transform creates a forward R recurrence whose sigma sign exactly chooses the accepted reflected right-half edge
claims.D6_completion: landing at local (0,r) is normalized to the next-sector anchor because R^k(0,r)=R^(k+1)(r,0); after six sectors R^6=id
claims.endpoint_orbit_equality: the endpoint sequence is exactly the AH D6 boundary, edge for edge
claims.simple_cycle: inside each sector a never increases, b never decreases, and every edge changes the endpoint; interior vertices have a>0,b>0. Rotated open-sector interiors are disjoint and neighboring sectors meet only at their common axis endpoint.
claims.no_early_endpoint_repeat: for r>0 no endpoint repeats before the final return to O+(r,0)
